audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits: immobile burst mage whose entire kill pattern needs one 18s-cooldown skillshot vs a gap-closing assassin. WR 48.47% is slightly under even but games are only 687; the kit logic and the site's own consistent chart both hold.
Spikes accurate: 3-5 bubble-dodge all-ins, 6 wall-R past Portal Jump, first item one-rotation, late flank. All 4 entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zoe was called he/his in 12+ fields (she/her). winCon and report[1] told the player to 'string the silence' — Zoe has no silence in her kit. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the sleep's doubled-damage-on-wake mechanic and the More Sparkles! auto-reset tell were missing from the full layer.
audit.why: Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is 18/17/16/15/14s; per Riot's text the sleep reduces MR and the first damage source that breaks it is doubled (capped). Her P empowers the next auto after any spell — the burst tell.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed everywhere lint flagged, silence removed, E cooldown and sleep-double mechanic written into cooldowns, P tell folded into breakdown.early.

audit.why: Her E at 18s rank 1 is the single cooldown the lane runs on.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.

notes: Chart fully consistent (Qiyana 7/7 on full, content and packet) — no chart edits. Zoe has no silence; the winCon/report[1] 'string the silence' line was a template leak and was replaced. suspectNames are near-misses, not fabrications: 'Sleepy Trouble Bubble' and 'Paddle Star' are correct (Riot styles Q as 'Paddle Star!'); 'Portal Jumps' is a plural of the real R name — left alone. missingInteractions: sleep's resistances angle and the More Sparkles! auto-reset tell were written in; the 'knockup-enabler on Spell Thief (W)' flag contradicts Riot's W description (summoner-spell pickup, no displacement) — derived-flag misfire, not written. Five report entries received pronoun-only corrections because lint flagged each explicitly; no other report rewrites. WR 48.47% vs FAVOURED 4/10 is a mild tension on 687 games; nothing in the kit justified flipping stages, so the chart stands.
